ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black pixels (medial region) to high-intensity white pixels (lateral lobes).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass centered at the medial notch and extending to the fluke base. Lateral lobes transition to high-intensity white backgrounds with high-frequency black linear streaks and mottling. Tan/brown pixel clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 85 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 1/8th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration across the entire boundary; right lobe exhibits a sequence of sharp, jagged peaks (3-8 pixel amplitude) and deep micro-valleys; left lobe shows a continuous sequence of smaller, irregular sawtooth protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral upward convexity following a parabolic curve terminating in acute, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 15-20 discrete, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters distributed across the lower-medial black pigment area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) slicing through the white pigment on both lobes, primarily oriented in vertical and diagonal vectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of raised, brownish biological organisms at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive irregular loss of edge continuity (chipping) along the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized brown/tan hued biological growth at the fluke tips, providing a unique texture and color contrast against the primary black-and-white epidermal palette.
